name: Carpe Diem
beschreibung:
Apartmenthaus Carpe Diem in Serfaus stands out with its sunny and quiet location on the renowned Tyrolean high plateau. The stylishly appointed apartments provide generous space, high-quality finishes, and private balconies overlooking the mountains.

The premier holiday region of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis is famous for family attractions, alpine adventure parks, and extensive hiking and skiing networks easily accessible from the property.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Carpe Diem in Serfaus offers modern holiday apartments on the sunny high plateau for families and mountain lovers.
